name: Baked Chicken Wings
desc: Wings tossed in olive oil, fresh garlic, chili powder and garlic powder, then baked until crisp.

source.title: Baked Chicken Wings
source.evidence: Same five-ingredient coating and 375°F oven; this version is the Allrecipes recipe scaled four times (3 tbsp oil to 3/4 cup, 3 garlic cloves to 12, 2 tsp chili powder to 2 tbsp plus 2 tsp) with a longer bake.

ingredients.raw: 4 lb chicken wings (about 40 flats and drumettes), patted dry

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Line 2 large rimmed baking sheets with foil for easier cleanup.
In a large bowl or gallon-size resealable bag, combine the olive oil, pressed garlic, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the wings and toss or shake until evenly coated.
Arrange the wings in a single layer on the baking sheets with space between them, and spoon any leftover garlic oil over the top.
Bake for 60-75 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the skin is crisp and browned and the thickest wing reads at least 165°F.
Optional: switch the oven to broil and broil for 3-5 minutes, watching closely, for extra-crisp skin.
tips: The Allrecipes original bakes 10 wings at 375°F for 30 to 45 minutes; a full 4 lb batch on crowded pans runs longer, so start checking at 45 minutes.

references.title: Baked Chicken Wings
references.usedFor: confirmed the coating ratios and 375°F oven; wings-per-serving basis for the estimate
